cost_boundary: The L0-L2 stack avoids mandatory paid extensions, MCP services, and external memory. Access to the selected primary agent is a separate prerequisite and may require an eligible subscription, organizational entitlement, API billing, or cloud-provider account.

profiles.purpose: Required foundation for a safe, reviewable local research workspace.
Adds local extraction, OCR, conversion, publishing, and bibliography tools when the research materials require them.
Adds a reproducible Python notebook environment; R remains a discipline-specific branch.

components.title: Primary agent account and access

access_cost.note: Choose one provider route. Provider access is not counted as a free Evidence Lab extension.

data.scope: Prompts and the project context selected for an agent task.
data.destination: Selected AI provider or approved cloud provider

system_requirements: Supported provider region and an eligible account route

lifecycle.install: Create or use an approved personal or organizational account for one primary host.
lifecycle.verify: Start the host and confirm the active account and billing route without exposing credentials.
lifecycle.update: Review entitlement, billing route, and organizational policy when the provider terms change.
lifecycle.remove: Sign out, revoke the local session, and remove the account connection under the provider policy.

verification.limitations: Pricing and data controls depend on the selected account and must be checked at consultation time.

components.title: Codex or Claude Code client

access_cost.note: The client has no separate Evidence Lab charge; provider access remains a separate prerequisite.

data.scope: Files opened by the client, commands, prompts, results, and local configuration.
data.destination: Local machine and selected AI provider

system_requirements: macOS, supported Linux, or Windows through the supported host route
Internet access for authentication and model use

lifecycle.install: Codex: run the official standalone installer. Claude Code: use the current native installer documented by Anthropic.
lifecycle.verify: Run `codex --version` or `claude --version`, then complete one read-only task in a test folder.
lifecycle.update: Codex: rerun the official installer. Claude Code: use automatic updates or `claude update`.
lifecycle.remove: Use the host's documented uninstall route, then inspect and remove only host-owned configuration after exporting required settings.

verification.limitations: Both clients were observed on Linux; clean install and removal still need macOS and WSL2 runs.

components.title: Isolated project workspace

access_cost.note: Uses a dedicated local folder and existing approved storage.

data.scope: Source files, notes, data, outputs, and checks for one research project.
data.destination: Local project folder and explicitly approved backup

system_requirements: Writable project directory
Sufficient storage for source files and generated outputs

lifecycle.install: Create one project folder with separate source, data, note, output, and check areas.
lifecycle.verify: Confirm the agent can read the folder and create one disposable test artifact only after approval.
lifecycle.update: Add folders through reviewed project instructions; preserve existing source paths.
lifecycle.remove: Export required outputs, then archive or delete the project folder under the researcher's retention policy.

verification.limitations: Backup provider and retention rules are client-specific.

components.title: Data boundary, backup, and secret handling

access_cost.note: Uses the client's approved backup and password-management services; Evidence Lab adds no service requirement.

license.value: Client policy and selected service terms

data.scope: Project data classification, backup copies, credentials, and excluded locations.
data.destination: Only client-approved storage and secret-management systems

system_requirements: Written data classification
Approved backup target
Existing password or secret manager

lifecycle.install: Record allowed data classes, excluded folders, backup destination, and credential-handling rule.
lifecycle.verify: Restore one harmless test file and confirm secrets are absent from the project and agent transcript.
lifecycle.update: Review the boundary when sources, collaborators, or provider settings change.
lifecycle.remove: Revoke project credentials and apply the client's retention and deletion policy to backups.

verification.limitations: Evidence Lab cannot certify a client's organizational backup or retention implementation.

components.title: Portable project instructions and structure

access_cost.note: Plain Markdown and JSON files stored with the project.

license.value: Client-owned content; Evidence Lab templates follow repository terms

data.scope: Project purpose, constraints, folder map, acceptance checks, and non-secret operating rules.
data.destination: Project repository and the active agent context

system_requirements: Text editor or agent file access
Project folder from L0

lifecycle.install: Create `AGENTS.md`, a Claude adapter when needed, `README.md`, decision log, acceptance checklist, and standard folders.
lifecycle.verify: Ask each host to state the project boundary and complete a small task under the same acceptance rule.
lifecycle.update: Review changes through Git and keep shared rules in `AGENTS.md` rather than duplicating them by host.
lifecycle.remove: Remove the template files only after exporting project-specific rules that must be retained.

verification.limitations: Behavior parity is structurally tested; a novice-user observation is still required.

components.title: Local Git history

access_cost.note: Git is free and does not require a remote repository.

data.scope: Tracked project files, diffs, commit metadata, and local history.
data.destination: Local `.git` directory; remote only when explicitly configured

system_requirements: Git available for the selected operating system

lifecycle.install: Install Git from the operating-system package or official distribution and initialize the project locally.
lifecycle.verify: Run `git --version`, inspect status, and create a reversible checkpoint without adding sensitive files.
lifecycle.update: Use the operating-system package manager or approved enterprise distribution.
lifecycle.remove: Archive required history, remove the project `.git` directory if requested, and uninstall Git through the package manager.

verification.limitations: Local Linux availability was checked; platform-specific installation remains to be run on macOS and WSL2.

components.title: Local file search with ripgrep

access_cost.note: ripgrep is a local open-source command-line tool.

data.scope: Local file names and matching text within the paths searched.
data.destination: Local process output

system_requirements: Supported ripgrep binary or a host-bundled copy

lifecycle.install: Use the host-bundled binary when available or install ripgrep from an approved package source.
lifecycle.verify: Run `rg --version` and search a test phrase inside the project boundary.
lifecycle.update: Update with the host or operating-system package that supplied the binary.
lifecycle.remove: Uninstall the standalone package; a host-bundled copy is removed with that host.

verification.limitations: The observed Linux host uses the copy bundled with Codex.

components.title: Permission and approval baseline

access_cost.note: Uses the selected host's built-in permission controls.

data.scope: Allowed file paths, command execution, network access, and approval decisions.
data.destination: Local host configuration and selected AI provider

system_requirements: Installed primary agent client
Known writable project boundary

lifecycle.install: Select a conservative permission profile and deny secret or unrelated folders.
lifecycle.verify: Confirm read access, require approval for a test write, and reject access outside the project boundary.
lifecycle.update: Review the profile before adding network access, automation, or new writable roots.
lifecycle.remove: Delete project overrides and restore the host's reviewed user defaults.

verification.limitations: Exact controls differ by host version and organization policy.

components.title: Web search with primary-source verification

access_cost.note: Uses host capabilities included in the selected access route; no third-party research service is required.

data.scope: Search queries, opened public pages, and citations retained in project outputs.
data.destination: Host search service and visited public websites

system_requirements: Network access approved for the task
A source-recording convention in the project

lifecycle.install: Enable only the built-in search route available to the selected host; add no external MCP at L1.
lifecycle.verify: Find one current fact, open the primary source, and save the source URL with the claim.
lifecycle.update: Recheck host availability and source policy when the platform changes.
lifecycle.remove: Disable network or search access in the host profile and remove stored test queries if policy requires it.

verification.limitations: Availability and quotas depend on the host account and current product surface.

components.title: Diff, checkpoint, and acceptance check

access_cost.note: Uses local Git, project acceptance criteria, and host review features.

data.scope: Changed files, diffs, validation output, and the acceptance decision.
data.destination: Local project history and agent context

system_requirements: Local Git initialized
Project acceptance checklist exists

lifecycle.install: Add a short acceptance checklist and require a checkpoint before material edits.
lifecycle.verify: Complete a small edit, inspect the diff, run its check, and restore the checkpoint once.
lifecycle.update: Revise acceptance criteria when the output type or research risk changes.
lifecycle.remove: Archive the final acceptance record before removing project-specific checks.

verification.limitations: The repository gate covers the pattern; client-specific acceptance checks still require a consultation run.

components.title: Evidence Lab frozen foundation

access_cost.note: Evidence Lab-owned packs are distributed under MIT with preserved third-party notices.

license.value: MIT; bundled third-party notices may add Apache-2.0

data.scope: Research prompts, local files, generated artifacts, and explicit tool outputs used by an activated skill.
data.destination: Primary agent provider; external destinations only for separately approved tools

system_requirements: Validated Evidence Lab profile
Supported Codex or Claude Code plugin host
Immutable release lock

lifecycle.install: Render the locked plan, obtain confirmation, apply exact pack versions, and read back the installed state.
lifecycle.verify: Require `status: ready`, exact installed versions, adapter parity, and a representative task before production acceptance.
lifecycle.update: Build a reconciliation plan against live readback; confirm additions and updates before applying them.
lifecycle.remove: Confirm removal separately, uninstall selected packs, read back the host, and retain a recovery record.

verification.limitations: Installation mechanics pass both-host tests, but all research packs remain draft pending representative runs and independent review.

components.title: Source ledger and decision trail

access_cost.note: Stored as project-owned structured files and Markdown records.

license.value: Client-owned records; template terms follow Evidence Lab licensing

data.scope: Source identity, retrieval path, decisions, exclusions, checks, and unresolved risks.
data.destination: Project source register and decision log

system_requirements: Project control files from L1
Defined record format for the selected workflow

lifecycle.install: Create the source register and decision log from reviewed templates.
lifecycle.verify: Trace one output claim back to its source and one methodological choice back to its decision entry.
lifecycle.update: Append dated entries; change the schema only through a reviewed migration.
lifecycle.remove: Export the records with the project handoff before applying the retention policy.

verification.limitations: A dedicated research-log capability is planned; source-ledger behavior is not yet accepted as an implemented foundation capability.

components.title: Installation state, update, and recovery

access_cost.note: State and plans are local project files generated by the Evidence Lab bootstrap.

data.scope: Pack IDs, versions, release identity, installation operations, and readback state without credentials.
data.destination: Project-local `.evidence-lab` state

system_requirements: Evidence Lab bootstrap and immutable release lock
Writable project state directory

lifecycle.install: Save the validated profile, locked plan, and exact post-install readback outside package source.
lifecycle.verify: Run bootstrap status or verify and compare the current host snapshot with the locked desired state.
lifecycle.update: Reconcile from the previous and new release locks; preserve the pre-change snapshot.
lifecycle.remove: Use the confirmed remove flow, verify absence through host readback, and keep the recovery receipt.

verification.limitations: Exact lifecycle behavior is test-covered with fake hosts; clean live removal is not yet evidenced for every supported OS.

components.title: PDF text extraction with Poppler

access_cost.note: Poppler tools run locally and are available through operating-system packages.

data.scope: Local PDF contents and extracted text files.
data.destination: Local process output

system_requirements: Poppler package for the selected operating system
Readable PDF input

lifecycle.install: Install Poppler from an approved operating-system package source.
lifecycle.verify: Run `pdftotext -v` and compare extracted text with one known text-layer PDF.
lifecycle.update: Update through the same package source.
lifecycle.remove: Uninstall the Poppler package and retain only project outputs required by policy.

verification.limitations: Binary availability was observed on Linux; extraction quality still needs the shared fixture set.

components.title: Scanned PDF OCR with OCRmyPDF

access_cost.note: OCRmyPDF is open-source local software; system dependencies vary by OS.

data.scope: Scanned PDF pages, generated OCR text layer, and diagnostic output.
data.destination: Local process output

system_requirements: OCRmyPDF and its documented native dependencies
Scanned PDF without a usable text layer

lifecycle.install: Install only in the Documents profile using the approved platform package route.
lifecycle.verify: Run OCR on a disposable scan and compare page count, text search, and visual rendering.
lifecycle.update: Update through the same package environment after a fixture regression test.
lifecycle.remove: Uninstall the package environment and its dedicated dependencies; retain source scans unchanged.

verification.limitations: OCRmyPDF was absent on the observed Linux host and has not passed the Evidence Lab fixture run.

components.title: Document conversion with Pandoc

access_cost.note: Pandoc runs locally; output engines may add separate dependencies.

data.scope: Local source documents, templates, metadata, and converted outputs.
data.destination: Local process output

system_requirements: Pandoc binary
Additional output engine only when the chosen format requires it

lifecycle.install: Install Pandoc from the official or approved operating-system package.
lifecycle.verify: Convert a fixture between Markdown and DOCX and compare required structure and references.
lifecycle.update: Update through the same package source and rerun conversion fixtures.
lifecycle.remove: Uninstall Pandoc and separately remove optional output engines if no longer used.

verification.limitations: The binary was observed on Linux; Evidence Lab conversion fixtures remain to be formalized.

components.title: Reproducible publishing with Quarto

access_cost.note: Quarto is open-source local software; rendering dependencies vary by output format.

data.scope: Project source, code cells, data references, citations, and rendered outputs.
data.destination: Local renderer and any explicitly used remote resources

system_requirements: Quarto CLI
Pandoc bundled with Quarto or compatible local installation
Selected computation engine when code is executed

lifecycle.install: Install only for projects that need multi-format or computation-backed publication.
lifecycle.verify: Render a fixture with a citation, table, formula, and code cell into the required format.
lifecycle.update: Update through the approved distribution and rerun the render fixture.
lifecycle.remove: Uninstall Quarto and optional render engines while retaining project source and final outputs.

verification.limitations: Quarto was absent on the observed Linux host and has not passed the Evidence Lab render fixture.

components.title: Bibliography with Zotero Desktop and managed export

access_cost.note: The local application is free; hosted storage beyond the free allowance is optional and separately priced.

data.scope: Bibliographic metadata, notes, attachments, and exported BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, or CSV files.
data.destination: Local Zotero library; Zotero services only when synchronization is enabled

system_requirements: Zotero Desktop for the selected operating system
Approved export format for the project

lifecycle.install: Install Zotero Desktop and keep agent access export-based until a plugin is separately approved.
lifecycle.verify: Export a small library and trace selected citations back to Zotero records and source files.
lifecycle.update: Update Zotero through its supported route and rerun the export fixture.
lifecycle.remove: Export the library and attachments, disable sync, sign out, and uninstall the desktop application.

verification.limitations: Zotero was absent on the observed Linux host; the canonical export combination is still an open product decision.

components.title: Python data environment with uv and Jupyter

access_cost.note: Python tooling is local and open source; project packages retain their own licenses.

license.value: uv: Apache-2.0 OR MIT; Jupyter Notebook: BSD-3-Clause

data.scope: Project datasets, environments, notebooks, scripts, caches, and generated analysis outputs.
data.destination: Local project environment and explicitly contacted data sources

system_requirements: Supported Python runtime managed through uv
Jupyter only when notebook interaction is required

lifecycle.install: Create a project-local uv environment and add only pinned packages required by the analysis; add Jupyter conditionally.
lifecycle.verify: Recreate the environment from its lock and run a deterministic notebook or script fixture.
lifecycle.update: Change dependencies through a reviewed lock update and rerun the analysis fixture.
lifecycle.remove: Delete the project-local environment and caches after preserving lock files, source, and required outputs.

verification.limitations: uv was present but Jupyter was absent on the observed Linux host; a locked end-to-end data fixture remains open.

components.title: R data environment

access_cost.note: R is an optional discipline-specific branch, not part of every L2 installation.

data.scope: Project datasets, R scripts, package library, lock file, and generated outputs.
data.destination: Local project environment and explicitly contacted data sources

system_requirements: R for the selected operating system
Project-local dependency lock when reproducibility is required

lifecycle.install: Install only when the discipline or laboratory uses R; create a project-local dependency record.
lifecycle.verify: Restore the dependency set and run one deterministic analysis fixture.
lifecycle.update: Review R and package changes together and rerun the fixture before adoption.
lifecycle.remove: Remove the project library and R installation only after preserving scripts, lock files, and required outputs.

verification.limitations: R was absent on the observed Linux host; no Evidence Lab R fixture has been executed.
